about_the_game:
Girl Next Door - is dating simulator with beutiful Cindy. You become a neighbor of a young and very pretty girl. It is in your power to make her notice you. Believe in yourself and luck will be on your side!



You have 28 days to gain the trust of a very beautiful girl. Find out her daily schedule, adjust to it and achieve your goal.
You can spy on Cindy in the toilet, shower or her room. Do it unnoticed and then there will be no problems!



Features:
  • Visit her room at night
  • Spy on her in the shower
  • Spy on her in the toilet
  • Spy while she changes clothes
  • Develop ease
  • Plenty of lewd scenes
  • Fascinating dialogues
  • Change of time of day
  • Several endings

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in the game are over 21 years old.
The game contains explicit adult themes, including nudity, violence, and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
